title: The injectivity threshold of a Gaussian ReLU layer
summary: We determine how wide a randomly initialized ReLU layer must be to distinguish every pair of inputs. For independent Gaussian weights and zero bias, as the dimensions grow at a fixed output-to-input ratio, the probability of global injectivity tends to zero below a sharp threshold and to one above it. We characterize this threshold exactly through a variational formula for the limiting minimum number of active neurons per input coordinate.
